name: Wyoming

jury_list.statute: No Wyoming statute or court rule found opens or closes juror qualification records. W.S. 1-11-109(c): 'If any person selected is not qualified to serve as a trial juror, the name of the person shall be stricken from the base jury list from which summoned.' 1-11-101(a)(i): a juror must be 'An adult citizen of the United States'. Status: null.

sources.cite: W.S. 1-11-101(a)(i) (juror must be an adult U.S. citizen)
W.S. 1-11-109(c) (names of persons not qualified are stricken from the base jury list)
Wyoming Rules Governing Access to Case Records (effective Feb. 5, 2024; the rule text does not mention jurors; the Access Security Matrix was not read)

voter_file.who_may_get: Candidates, campaign committees, party central committees and officials, elected officials, political action committees, 'individuals promoting or opposing a ballot issue or candidate' and 'organizations which promote voter participation' (W.S. 22-2-113(a)). The Secretary of State's form requires proof of the category.
voter_file.permitted_uses: 'All lists are for political purposes only and are not available for commercial use.' (W.S. 22-2-113(a)).
voter_file.use_restriction: W.S. 22-2-113(a): 'All lists are for political purposes only and are not available for commercial use.'
voter_file.penalty: The Secretary of State's order form says 'violations of W.S. 22-2-113(a) will be referred for prosecution as a misdemeanor under W.S. 22-26-112'. 22-26-112 sets up to six months in jail or a $1,000 fine for listed acts 'if knowingly and willfully committed'; whether its list covers 22-2-113(a) was not confirmed.
voter_file.attestation_required: Signed oath on the Secretary of State's form: 'I affirm under penalty of perjury that I will use the above voter registration data for political purposes only and that I will not use it for commercial purposes.'

sources.cite: W.S. 22-2-113(d) (birth dates and other identifiers are not public records)
Wyoming Secretary of State, Voter Registry List Request Form (oath; political purposes only; fields include Registration Date)

private_challenge.who: No private pre-election challenge was found. The county clerk may investigate any registration when there is reasonable cause to believe the voter may be unqualified, and strikes unqualified names after a thorough investigation (W.S. 22-3-105(a)).

county_board.name: Wyoming county clerks (Secretary of State, PDF)
county_board.note: The county clerk may investigate registrations on reasonable cause (W.S. 22-3-105).

audit_path.statute: W.S. 16-4-203 (Public Records Act), 22-2-113(d) ('all election records of the county clerk are public', subject to the Public Records Act) and 52 U.S.C. 20507(i) (NVRA public inspection of list-maintenance records)
audit_path.what_you_can_request: Counts only, from the county clerk: per year, the number of names struck from the registration lists under W.S. 22-3-105 because the person was not qualified as a U.S. citizen.
audit_path.note: Do not ask for names. No Wyoming statute sends juror citizenship answers to election officials. Whether clerks keep counts by reason was not confirmed.

gates.basis: Jury records: no Wyoming statute or court rule found opens or closes them, so public stays null and the app shows counts only. No private challenge; the county clerk investigates on reasonable cause (W.S. 22-3-105). Strict gates.

notes: CHANGED 2026-10-07: applied under Optimus standing rule (no gate loosens). jury_list statute and sources (1-11-101, 1-11-109(c)); voter_file filled from 22-2-113 and the Secretary of State form (it was all null); audit_path; federal_source_url moved to govinfo. jury_list.public stays null. official_pipeline stays null. No gate changes. 2026-10-07 (Optimus final rulings, REQ-NOTE 65): voter_file.use_restriction added with the exact statutory text (copied from permitted_uses); the app shows it and requires the user's attestation before the voter file loads.

Registration date (approved by Optimus 2026-10-07; REQ-NOTE 62 closed): voter_file.registration_date_in_public_file null -> true. The registry list is defined to include 'registration dates' (W.S. 22-1-102(a)(xxix)) and the form lists 'Registration Date'. This turns on the date rule for Wyoming files. dob_in_public_file null -> false: 'birth dates' are 'not public records and shall be kept confidential' (22-2-113(d)).

Use limit: only the listed political categories may get the registry list (22-2-113(a)). A JuryRoll user outside those categories cannot lawfully get it. The app should warn Wyoming users before loading a voter file.

PA-style check: names of persons not qualified are 'stricken' (1-11-109(c)). No statute keeps a list of reasons. The former Rules Governing Access to Court Records (repealed 2024) listed 'Trial juror addresses, qualification forms, and questionnaires' as confidential; the current rules' matrix was not read. A secondary source (Reporters Committee) says juror questionnaires are confidential by court rule; not relied on.
official_pipeline is null: no Wyoming statute sends juror citizenship information to election officials. The NCSL table of jury-list pipelines (updated Sept. 1, 2026) does not list Wyoming.
Cancelled-voter file: no published Wyoming cancelled-voter file with a jury reason code was found. REQ-NOTE 27 drops cancelled rows before matching.
Source note: Wyoming Statutes read from the official wyoleg.gov title PDFs on 2026-10-07.
